risks: The recommendation to consider migrating an existing legacy map is softer than the categorical then clause; a weak planner could postpone migration indefinitely, although the rewrite appropriately avoids inventing a migration deadline or invalidity rule.

The coder-facing fields do not spell out how to recover a legacy map entry's wagon slug or whether its description must be retained during migration, so migrating descriptions may require repository context; this does not obscure the required declaration format.
